name: Ouno Makito
source: [spoiler]Makito was involved in an accident and nearly lost his life. Consequently, various parts of his body had to be replaced with advanced artificial organs, specifically his heart, right arm, eyes, and ears. This is the reason he possesses superhuman abilities such as overclocking.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]Makito was involved in an accident and nearly lost his life.
